protocol.purpose: A second party tries to show that a lane's neutral-looking selection universe was gerrymandered, target-first, or made non-comparable by source access.
protocol.clearing_rule: Cleared requires a reviewer distinct from the universe author, at least two recorded boundary attacks, at least one plausible alternative universe, at least one comparator test, and a written disposition.
required_challenges: Move each temporal, geographic, institutional, source-family, and threshold boundary and record who enters or leaves.
Propose the strongest plausible alternative universe that answers the same public-interest question.
Apply the stated rule to at least one unflattering and one exculpatory or null comparator outcome.
Test whether differential source access, deletion, language, jurisdiction, or digitization makes symmetry merely nominal.

known_boundary_risks: Declared UK/US case sources may overrepresent English-language and digitally durable institutions.
Receipt-led expansion can inherit the seed case's institutional boundary.
reviews.disposition: Existing exports remain provisional and must carry the consumption contract until an independent challenge is recorded.

known_boundary_risks: A publisher-defined ranking universe may encode editorial and sponsor choices before this project applies its own rules.
The unrecovered 2025 image roster can distort longitudinal inclusion.
reviews.disposition: Lane remains staged and publication-blocked pending independent universe review and complete roster recovery.

known_boundary_risks: Configured APIs privilege digitized US records and sources that permit stable automated access.
Query-term choice can make an apparently complete source matrix target-first.
reviews.disposition: Source-plane outputs remain provisional and expose adapter failures, held rows, and query boundaries.

known_boundary_risks: The archive is egocentric and attention-selected, so it cannot support population or absence inference.
reviews.disposition: No public universe is claimed; private rows remain support-only and require separate public receipts for any assertion.

known_boundary_risks: Government release boundaries reflect institutional disclosure and redaction decisions rather than the universe of conduct.
Survivorship and publicity can overrepresent famous names and durable institutions.
reviews.disposition: Lane remains proposed and publication-blocked before source-complete hashing, privacy fixtures, and independent universe review.

known_boundary_risks: A named reference case can silently become target-first even when its predicates are written symmetrically.
Different officeholders disclose different entity structures, making comparator availability uneven.
reviews.disposition: Lane remains proposed and publication-blocked until identifiers, adapters, matched comparators, and independent review exist.

known_boundary_risks: One leak's service-provider and jurisdiction footprint is not the universe of offshore finance.
Registry accessibility varies by jurisdiction and can create false asymmetry in validation rates.
reviews.disposition: Lane remains proposed and publication-blocked until a licensed snapshot, privacy projection, and independent universe review exist.
